title: Payments DB Pool Exhaustion Recovery
steps: 1. Check recent changes to db_pool.yaml and revert if max_connections was reduced.
2. Run graceful connection pool recycle on payments-api pods.
3. Verify active DB connections drop below 70% in Cloud Monitoring.

title: Cart Cache Stampede Recovery
steps: 1. Compare the current cache TTL with the last known good value.
2. Restore the TTL if it changed.
3. Warm the cart cache and verify page latency is below 1 second.

title: Search Node Disk Recovery
steps: 1. Identify the node with high disk usage.
2. Remove indices past the retention period.
3. Verify cluster health returns to green.

title: Partner API Credential Rotation
steps: 1. Confirm the authorization failure in the sync logs.
2. Rotate the partner credentials in the secret manager.
3. Rerun the stock sync and verify the record counts.
